faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IARI Young Professional-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICAR IARI Young Professional-II position is 20th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Bachelor's degree with at least 60% marks in relevant computer science fields and one year of experience, or a Master's degree in the same fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years for all candidates applying for the Young Professional-II post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000 per month for the duration of their contractual employment.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the ICAR IARI Young Professional-II job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the specified email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Young Professional-II role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Young Professional-II position at ICAR IARI is a contractual job. The duration and terms of the contract will be as per the institute's policy.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Indian Agricultural Research Institute located?
faq.answer: The Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI) is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110012.
